name: Competition Management System
description: A 4-layer .NET application for managing competitive events, participants, and results.

layers.name: API Layer
layers.description: Presentation layer. HTTP endpoints, DTOs, request/response mapping. Thin, stateless.
responsibilities: Route HTTP requests to application services
Map DTOs to domain objects (delegating to Application)

layers.name: Application Layer
layers.description: Use cases and orchestration. Application services coordinate domain logic and infrastructure.
responsibilities: Orchestrate domain entities and domain services
Handle transactions and cross-cutting concerns (logging, validation)
Translate between API DTOs and Domain objects
Call repositories and external services (via Domain interfaces)

layers.name: Domain Layer
layers.description: Business logic and rules. Pure domain model, persistence-agnostic.
responsibilities: Define domain services for cross-aggregate logic

layers.name: Infrastructure Layer
layers.description: Technical implementations. Data access, external services, logging, DI setup.
responsibilities: Connect to databases, message queues, external APIs
Provide logging, caching, and other cross-cutting concerns
Configure dependency injection (wired at API layer startup)

boundary_rules.description: API depends on Application; Application depends on Domain; Infrastructure depends on Domain. Never reverse.

boundary_rules.rule: Domain is pure and ignorant of layers above
boundary_rules.description: Domain must have zero dependencies on API, Application, or Infrastructure implementation classes.

boundary_rules.rule: Infrastructure depends on Domain interfaces, never APIs
boundary_rules.description: Infrastructure implements repository interfaces defined in Domain; it does NOT depend on Application services or API controllers.
Controllers inject application services. No business logic in controllers. Minimal validation (shape checking only).

constraints.name: No synchronous I/O in Domain
constraints.description: Domain methods should not perform I/O. Defer I/O to Application layer via repository interfaces.

constraints.name: Entities are mutable only within aggregate boundaries
constraints.description: Only aggregate roots should be mutable. Navigation properties should be read-only collections.

constraints.name: No null-pointer exceptions in Domain
constraints.description: Use value objects and invariants to prevent invalid states. Fail fast in constructors.
